options.flight.title: flight Settings
options.flight.enabled.tooltip: Whether you can take off in every game mode now by double-tapping jump, as in Creative mode. It does not start a flight by itself. The toggle key switches the same setting. It has no effect on servers the multiplayer mode rules out.
options.flight.singleplayer_default.tool: The state restored in singleplayer worlds when a reset applies.
options.flight.multiplayer_default.toolt: The state restored on servers the multiplayer mode allows when a reset applies.
options.flight.reset_on_world_exit.toolt: Every world starts from its default state instead of keeping the last state.
options.flight.reset_on_game_exit.toolti: After restarting the game, the first world where the mod is allowed starts from its default state.
options.flight.multiplayer_mode.whitelis: Active only on servers in the server list.
options.flight.multiplayer_mode.blacklis: Active on all servers except those in the server list.
options.flight.edit_servers.tooltip: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
options.flight.servers.title: Server List
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.flight: Lets the local player fly like in Creative mode in every game mode.
